name: AdopPlant API (Python 3.14 + PostgreSQL 18)
postCreateCommand: python3 -m venv /home/vscode/venv && /home/vscode/venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt && /home/vscode/venv/bin/python -m alembic upgrade head || echo 'No se pudo aplicar Alembic: revisa la base del devcontainer (psql -h db -U postgres -d plant)'
postAttachCommand: echo 'API:      /home/vscode/venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000' && echo 'Swagger:  http://localhost:8000/docs' && echo 'Pruebas:  /home/vscode/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q' && echo 'Web:      node --test tests/*.cjs' && echo 'Base:     psql -h db -U postgres -d plant'
